_comment: Maps every point of TODO-tests-linux.md « To confirm on Linux » to the Linux field report evidence that decides it. Each unchecked TODO line carries <!-- field-point: <id> --> on its first line. A check names a step of data/field_run_steps.json (the daemon's field run) or of data/field_guided_steps.json (the collector's probe and guided steps, tools/dev/field-guided.py), optionally the report steps that decide it. A point with no check states why a field report cannot test it (not_testable). tools/dev/field-todo-summary.py --os linux gives one verdict per point (docs/tooling/linux-field-report-coverage.md); tests/unit/infra/control/test_field_todo_coverage.lua fails when a TODO line has no entry or an entry names a missing step.

points.title: Raw telemetry rows (window topology, network, WireGuard)
points.condition: An X11 session with Metrics on; a second monitor and a WireGuard tunnel for the matching steps (each can be skipped by name).

points.title: Wayland focus on GNOME and KDE
points.condition: A GNOME Shell 45+ or Plasma Wayland session after install.sh (and a new login on GNOME).
points.not_testable: GNOME, Plasma 6 and Plasma 5 are separate sessions: one report proves the session it runs in; run it once per desktop.

points.title: Physical acceptance (grabs, polkit, autostart, wizard, magic key, hotplug)
points.condition: A real desktop on a kernel with uinput and evdev.
points.not_testable: Wayland and X11 are separate sessions, and real kernel capture with ordered pairs (93) needs Xorg or a compositor reading the daemon's virtual keyboard: run the report once per session type.

points.title: Item 50 cascade and the composed layout on a physical keyboard
Layout emulation W1 to W4 on KDE
points.condition: A KDE Plasma Wayland session with the Bépo registry layout.

points.title: Physical shortcut delivery (LIN-004)
points.condition: A real keyboard under the evdev grab (decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-11: the getter answers true).

points.title: Predictions stop on activity
points.condition: A slow local model; a mouse, a wheel and a touchpad.

points.title: Branch wave3/input-policies: sticky delay, CapsWord menu, one-shot Shift device
One-shot modifiers: no time limit, sticky actions, AltGr tap-hold pair
points.condition: A real keyboard; a GTK and a Qt application.
points.not_testable: Which modifiers the application received after a `sticky_*` action is a person's reading of the typed result: the report proves only the sticky delay row.
